metadata.title: Macachor Absolute: Scalar-First Ontology v3.0.2 — Peer-Reviewed Empirical Bridges
metadata.description: The Macachor Absolute framework presents a scalar-first ontology in which all vector, spinor, and tensor structures emerge as relational observables from frame-dependent apertures. This v3.0.2 release incorporates three independent peer-reviewed empirical validations: (1) Fedida & Głowacki's relational QFT formalization proving scalar-first consistency; (2) PRL 2022's universal L⁴ dipole polarizability scaling law providing direct density differential measurement; and (3) Veranda et al. / Widmer et al. / Ryzhkov's magneto-inertial fusion self-organization data demonstrating spontaneous scalar density equilibrium in macroscopic plasma systems. This release also includes the Chebotarev erratum, reframing the previous false equivalence claim as a valid structural analogy.
